newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Euroairport total Jan-Oct cargo traffic up 14 pct.
newsitem.headline: Euroairport total Jan-Oct cargo traffic up 14 pct.

text.p: Overall cargo traffic handled at Basle-Mulhouse-Freiburg airport, situated on the French-Swiss border, in the first ten months of 1996, totalled 73,067 tonnes, an increase of 14 percent on the same period last year, airport authority figures show.
January-October 1996 airfreight traffic handled at the airport, officially known as EuroAirport, totalled 40,832 tonnes, an increase of 29 percent on 1995 levels.
Airfreight carried on scheduled full-freighter services increased by 48 percent to 26,856 tonnes, the airport authority added.
In contrast, express airfreight handled at the airport during Jan-Oct, fell by 11 percent on 1995 levels to 8,886 tonnes.
Jan-Oct 1996 trucked airfreight traffic was down one percent on last year's levels at 32,235 tonnes.
Postal traffic totalled 2,798 tonnes, up nine percent on the first ten months of 1995. - Air Cargo Newrooms Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
